newsitem.title: USA: Vesta Insurance to pay $238.75 mln for insurer.
newsitem.headline: Vesta Insurance to pay $238.75 mln for insurer.

text.p: Vesta Insurance Group Inc said Thursday that it has entered into a stock purchase agreement to acquire the operating subsidiaries of Anthem Casualty Insurance Group Inc for $238.75 million in cash.

The transaction, said the company, is expected to close by July 1. Anthem Casualty, whose major business is auto insurance and homeowners insurance in small towns and suburbs, is a unit of privately-held Anthem Inc, an Indianapolis based health management company.
Vesta is a holding company for a group of property and casualty insurance companies that offer reinsurance and primary insurance on personal and commercial lines.
